case_scope: Transportation access, housing-plus-transportation burden, and place affordability

place_public_finance_gate.note: Housing affordability must be netted against transportation cost, access, reliability, disability access, and vehicle/repair exposure.

transportation_access_cost_burden.note: BTS cost-burden evidence and H+T place measures show transportation can be the second rent; the lowest income quintile spent a disproportionate share of income on transportation. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD geographic-opportunity evidence is now bound to place-access and transport-burden scoring.

public_service_floor_place_equality.note: Access to jobs, schools, care, food, courts, and health services must be scored by reachable opportunities, not municipal boundaries.

municipal_fiscal_capacity.note: Transit, sidewalks, roads, and mobility infrastructure require operating subsidies, capital maintenance, and local fiscal capacity.

user_fee_special_assessment_regressivity.note: Fares, tolls, parking, fines, impoundment, insurance, repairs, and vehicle debt can reprice place benefits regressively.

proof_debt: combined housing-plus-transportation burden by income and locality
transit reliability, frequency, coverage, and last-mile access
vehicle debt, insurance, repair, fuel, and repossession burden
fines, fees, tolls, parking, and impoundment exposure

gate_15_place_public_finance.why: Gate 15 remains watch: place affordability cannot pass unless transportation cost, reachable opportunity, and reliability evidence show usable public-service wealth.

evidence_debt_register.question: combined housing-plus-transportation burden by income and locality
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Use H+T and BTS burden measures to test whether cheap housing actually lowers total cost at the threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.question: transportation insecurity and missed-work/school/care rates
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure missed work, school, medical, court, childcare, and food access events caused by unreliable transportation.

evidence_debt_register.question: transit reliability, frequency, coverage, and last-mile access
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Score frequency, span of service, reliability, transfers, first/last mile, and low-wage/nonstandard schedule fit.

evidence_debt_register.question: paratransit/disability access and compliance
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Document eligibility, wait times, trip denial, same-day feasibility, fare burden, and ADA/service-quality outcomes.

evidence_debt_register.question: vehicle debt, insurance, repair, fuel, and repossession burden
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Bridge this case to auto-finance evidence so car-dependent places do not hide mobility collateral risk.

evidence_debt_register.question: fines, fees, tolls, parking, and impoundment exposure
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure whether mobility costs become legal/fee liabilities that threaten licenses, credit, or employment.

validation_notes: rev0335 removed stale place_public_finance_gate_seed calibration label; active scoring now requires source-backed service-floor, fiscal-capacity, and threshold-moment evidence.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S48 to `transportation_access_cost_burden` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
